definitions.gloss: bad harvest; poor crop; crop failure
definitions.explanation: A season in which agricultural yields are significantly lower than expected, typically due to weather or natural disasters. The opposite is {豊作|ほうさく} (bumper crop).

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{不作|ふさく}だった。
examples.english: This year's rice crop was poor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日照|にっしょう}→日照：21173_nisshou⟧{不足|ぶそく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{不作|ふさく}になった。
examples.english: Lack of sunshine caused a poor vegetable harvest.

examples.japanese: {不作|ふさく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{小麦|こむぎ}→小麦：01407_komugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: Wheat prices rose significantly due to the poor harvest.

notes:
A poor harvest or crop failure, typically caused by bad weather, drought, or natural disasters. Commonly appears in agricultural news and discussions about food prices.

FORMS:
{不|ふ} (un-, bad) + ⟦{作|さく}→作：27430_saku⟧ (production, crop).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不作|ふさく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧: a year of poor harvest
- {大|だい}{不作|ふさく}: severe crop failure
- {不作|ふさく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧: impact of the poor harvest
- {不作|ふさく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: poor harvests continue

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{豊作|ほうさく}→豊作：14227_housaku⟧: bumper crop, abundant harvest (opposite)
- ⟦{凶作|きょうさく}→凶作：16485_kyousaku⟧: catastrophic crop failure (more severe than {不作|ふさく})
